target_customer: Training providers, apprenticeship providers and FE colleges
target_role: Leaders deciding whether to buy an ongoing marketing package
problem_solved: The provider does not yet know which employers to target.
product_description: Maps competitive position, defines an ideal partner profile and builds a first-pass target account list. Every package is said to start with this audit. It is described as fixed-price. The figure is not on the homepage.
price_mechanism: Described as fixed-price. Amount NOT PUBLISHED.
strategy_included: Competitive position and a first-pass target account list are named outputs.
free_entry_offer: No. It is a paid audit. The amount is not published.
next_obvious_paid_product: Foundation, Growth or Full Department package
likely_upsell: A monthly package. Judgement: the audit exists to choose the tier.
evidence_notes: Homepage says every package starts with a Go-to-Market Audit and calls the audit a focused fixed-price way to see how they work. No pound figure and no VAT wording.
analysis_likely_funnel_role: Paid diagnostic that selects the retainer
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A bounded first purchase before a monthly commitment
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Scopes the account list that later drives the retainer price
analysis_likely_margin_profile: Unknown, because the price is hidden
analysis_recurring_revenue_potential: low on its own; high as the door to a retainer
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: A fixed-price audit whose job is to point at a named monthly tier is already how an ITP agency sells £3,500 to £8,500 packages. Four Corners should publish the audit price, because this competitor does not.

target_customer: Smaller or earlier-stage training providers
target_role: Provider leaders who need one lead-generation channel
problem_solved: No consistent employer lead channel.
product_description: One lead-generation channel, built and run. Fortnightly contact.
delivery_1to1_group_team: Team delivery for one provider. Contact is fortnightly.
number_of_sessions: Fortnightly contact. A session count is NOT PUBLISHED.
consultancy_included: Strategy is described as included with delivery across the packages
implementation_included: Yes. The channel is built and run.
reporting_frequency: A reporting rhythm is claimed for every package. The interval is NOT PUBLISHED for this tier.
strategy_included: Yes, as part of strategy and delivery
likely_upsell: Growth, or a social channel package
evidence_notes: Homepage from-price. No hours, no VAT, no minimum term, no statement on whether media spend is included.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: One working channel without hiring a department
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: A lower entry retainer that can move up
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: £3,500 a month from-price, with fortnightly contact, is the published floor for an outsourced ITP marketing channel. It is above Four Corners' £2,000 advisory test and below the £4,000 supported test.

target_customer: Training and apprenticeship providers that want an outsourced marketing department
problem_solved: One channel is not enough to create and nurture employer demand.
product_description: Multi-channel: outbound, content, nurture and sales enablement. Weekly contact. Described as the outsourced marketing department.
likely_upsell: Full Department or Full Ownership social
evidence_notes: Homepage. Sales enablement is named. The account-based marketing page says coaching the business development team is not part of the core offer today.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A department without a headcount
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: The main revenue product
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: £6,000 a month from-price sits between Four Corners' £4,000 and £8,000 tests. The published difference from Foundation is more channels and weekly rather than fortnightly contact, not a published hour count.

target_customer: Providers that want brand, PR, events and campaigns as well as lead generation
problem_solved: Marketing is still not represented as a full function at leadership level.
product_description: Full function: brand, PR, events and campaigns, with SLT and board involvement, described as an embedded fractional CMO.
delivery_1to1_group_team: Embedded with SLT and board. Hours NOT PUBLISHED.
account_management: SLT and board involvement. Meeting frequency NOT PUBLISHED beyond the package family.
likely_upsell: More accounts, or social Full Ownership
evidence_notes: Homepage from-price. No hour allocation.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: Senior involvement plus a full function
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Highest published monthly floor
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: The published top ITP marketing retainer starts at £8,500 a month, close to Four Corners' £8,000 managed test, and is still a from-price. Hours are not published, so the buyer is buying a function, not a timesheet.

target_customer: Apprenticeship providers
target_role: Marketing teams that will post the content themselves
problem_solved: No batch of channel-specific content.
product_description: One-off batch, filmed and edited, handed over. No ongoing management. LinkedIn and TikTok are treated as different jobs.
done_for_you_included: Production only. Posting stays with the client.
evidence_notes: Homepage social ladder.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A finished batch without a retainer
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: A way in for buyers who will not start at £3,500 a month
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: A one-off content batch from £1,800 sits under the retainer and is explicitly not management.

target_customer: Apprenticeship providers
target_role: Teams that will post and manage the channel themselves
problem_solved: Need content production without handing over the channel.
product_description: Content production only. The client posts and manages the channel.
evidence_notes: Homepage.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: Content without losing control of the channel
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Recurring production with a clear exclusion
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: The exclusion is the product. Saying what the client still does justifies a lower monthly price.

target_customer: Apprenticeship providers
target_role: Marketing leads who do not want to post
problem_solved: The channel is not being posted, scheduled or lightly managed.
product_description: Full posting, scheduling, light community management and reporting.
done_for_you_included: Yes, for posting and light community management
reporting_frequency: Reporting is included. Frequency NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Homepage.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: The channel runs without internal posting time
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: More ownership than production-only
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Adding posting, scheduling and light community management is a published step from £2,200 to £3,800 a month.

target_customer: Apprenticeship providers
target_role: Leaders who want both LinkedIn and TikTok run for them
problem_solved: Learner and employer social are different jobs and neither is owned.
product_description: Both channels, paid amplification, learner takeovers, and one ghostwritten profile. Additional profiles are an add-on on the social service page.
next_obvious_paid_product: Growth or Full Department if not already bought
evidence_notes: Homepage price. Ghostwriting add-on is described at https://skillsmarketing.co.uk/services/social-media/ without a price.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: Both audiences covered, including paid
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: A social product that can match the Growth retainer price
analysis_likely_margin_profile: Unknown. Paid amplification may or may not be inside the fee.
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Paid amplification is named inside the top social tier. Whether the media budget is extra is NOT PUBLISHED, so Four Corners should state that exclusion even if this competitor does not.

target_customer: UK businesses of about £2m to £20m turnover, including training providers and colleges
problem_solved: Marketing activity has no senior owner, and a full-time marketing director is not yet justified.
product_description: Board-level marketing leadership. Sets strategy, leads the team and agencies, controls priorities and budget, and reports commercial numbers. Channel work is delivered by the client's employees and suppliers. The training-provider page says ongoing work is typically two to four days a month, including SLT meetings and board reporting, after an audit and a 90-day plan. That page does not publish a separate fee.
price: From £1,500/month for strategic advisory. FAQ: £3,000 to £6,000 per month for embedded leadership at one to two days per week.
price_mechanism: from monthly retainer, then a fixed-price proposal
expert_live_hours: Training-provider page: typically two to four days per month. FAQ embedded tier: one to two days per week. These are not the same capacity and are not reconciled on one page.
delivery_1to1_group_team: One principal with the client's leadership team
implementation_included: Direction of implementation. He states he does not personally deliver every channel.
done_for_you_included: No. Employees and suppliers deliver the channel work.
reporting_frequency: Reports pipeline and performance to the board. Frequency NOT PUBLISHED.
report_included: Board reporting is part of the role. A standard report template is NOT PUBLISHED.
action_plan_included: A 90-day plan is part of the described path
evidence_notes: Prices from the homepage and its FAQ, fetched 5 October 2026. Education shape from https://mccrackenmarketing.co.uk/fractional-cmo-training-providers/ which publishes days and a 90-day plan but not a fee. Other pages mention different bands and were not used as the price.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: Senior owner without a salary
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Sells his own time, not a delivery team
analysis_likely_margin_profile: High if the work stays advisory, because there is no delivery team on the page
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: A solo fractional price starts at £1,500 a month and the embedded band is £3,000 to £6,000. That is general UK pricing, also offered to training providers. It is not evidence that an ITP will pay the same for a team that also produces the campaigns.

target_customer: Businesses that want a diagnosis before ongoing support
problem_solved: Spend, team, data and pipeline have not been independently reviewed.
product_description: Independent review of strategy, positioning, spend, team, data and pipeline, followed by a prioritised 90-day plan.
report_included: A prioritised 90-day plan is the stated output. A separate diagnostic report title is NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Homepage. A North West page snippet mentioned an audit from £750. That page was not used, because it conflicts with this from-price and was not fetched in full.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A plan before a retainer
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Converts a free call into a small project
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: A 90-day plan after a review is published from £1,500, with VAT unstated. That is the nearest general benchmark for a Commercial Growth Diagnostic, and it is not an education-only price.

target_customer: Leadership teams
problem_solved: The leadership team needs one prepared working day and a written plan.
product_description: A prepared leadership workshop followed by a written 90-day action plan.
duration: Described as a strategy day. Hour count NOT PUBLISHED.
next_obvious_paid_product: Fractional CMO or Marketing Effectiveness Review
evidence_notes: Homepage price. The detail link was not opened, so inclusions beyond the workshop and the written plan are NOT PUBLISHED.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: One day and a plan
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: A product under the review price
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: A strategy day with a written 90-day plan is published from £1,250. Four Corners' £295 to £595 workshops are a different depth unless the output is equally specific.

target_customer: Businesses with a sudden leadership gap
problem_solved: Recruitment, change or absence leaves marketing without a senior owner.
product_description: Temporary senior cover. Leadership continuity.
expert_live_hours: A day rate. Days per week NOT PUBLISHED.
done_for_you_included: Leadership cover, not a campaign factory
next_obvious_paid_product: Fractional CMO once the gap changes
evidence_notes: Homepage and FAQ. FAQ also says project and day-rate work is available from £500 per day, and that engagements are fixed-price proposals rather than open-ended day-rate arrangements.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: Continuity
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Uses spare days at a published floor
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: A published senior marketing day rate starts at £500. Four Corners' £1,500 a day working rate is three times that floor and would need a different output to be comparable. This is not an education-only rate.

target_customer: FE colleges and private training providers
problem_solved: Employer sales, key accounts and the wider staff who meet employers are under-skilled.
product_description: Three named programmes: solution selling skills; key account management; employer engagement ambassadors for trainers, assessors and curriculum staff. Custom units are included. The price is not published.
implementation_included: Customisation is included. Follow-up implementation is NOT PUBLISHED.
done_for_you_included: Outsourced business development is a separate unnamed-price offer
evidence_notes: Page re-fetched 5 October 2026. Still no price, duration or toolkit. Legal entity from the 2 October 2026 Companies House match.
analysis_likely_funnel_role: Capability workshop that can lead to outsourcing
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A facilitator who has run provider businesses
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Training opens the door to outsourced business development
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: The nearest named sales trainer for colleges and ITPs still does not publish a price, a day length or a leave-behind.

target_customer: FE colleges and training providers
target_role: Cross-college managers, delivery leaders and support teams
problem_solved: Business development, curriculum and support do not operate as one employer-responsive service.
product_description: Three programmes: creating an integrated employer responsive service; performance management for work-based learning; developing high performing teams. The integrated programme is described as four sessions, including an operational plan and KPIs.
number_of_sessions: Four sessions are described for the integrated programme. Hours NOT PUBLISHED.
action_plan_included: The integrated programme aims at an operational plan. A template is NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Not re-opened on 5 October 2026. No price was on the page on 2 October 2026.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: The whole organisation, not only the sales team
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: A second purchase inside the same college
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Employer-account growth is sold as an organisation workshop. Four Corners can treat that as the shape of a programme even though the fee is hidden.

product_name: Lead generation and employer meeting booking
target_customer: Larger training providers, colleges and universities with an existing sales team
problem_solved: Salespeople spend their time prospecting instead of attending qualified meetings.
product_description: Creates qualified employer opportunities for the client's existing sales team. Channels named: telemarketing, LinkedIn, email, SEO and multi-channel campaigns. The page does not split those channels into separate prices.
done_for_you_included: Prospecting and meeting booking. Conversion stays with the client.
reporting_frequency: Clear reporting is claimed for the outsourced service. Frequency NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: No price. The claim of more than 200 apprenticeship sign-ups in the last year is a marketing claim, not a client-level result. Registered office on Companies House is 1 Devon Way; the website prints 2 Devon Way, same postcode.
analysis_likely_funnel_role: Campaign for buyers who already have sellers
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: More meetings without more headcount
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Uses a calling team the provider does not want to employ
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Some buyers want meetings, not a strategy. A Growth Partnership that does not say whether it books employer meetings will be compared with this offer.

target_customer: Smaller and growing training providers without a dedicated sales team
problem_solved: The provider can deliver programmes but cannot run employer sales.
product_description: Manages the employer sales process through to commitment and sign-up. The page says costs can be planned around the campaign and that activity can be increased or reduced. No fee, day rate or per-start price is published.
price_mechanism: bespoke quote. Performance fee NOT PUBLISHED.
done_for_you_included: Yes, through to the agreed commitment stage
account_management: Regular contact with employers is claimed. Client meeting rhythm NOT PUBLISHED.
reporting_frequency: Clear reporting and measurable outcomes are claimed. Frequency NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: No numeric price. Cheaper than employing a team is a claim, not a price.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: Sign-ups without employing salespeople
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Higher share of the sales job than meeting booking
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Outsourced employer sales already exists as a product. Four Corners' managed partnership should say whether it stops at marketing assets or continues to employer commitment.

target_customer: Universities, colleges and independent training providers
problem_solved: The internal team needs qualified employer leads rather than a cold-calling function.
product_description: Fully managed campaigns including targeted prospect data, telemarketers who speak to HR and directors, email marketing, and campaign reporting and analysis. Sold as a bespoke proposal.
done_for_you_included: Yes. The calls and data are included.
reporting_frequency: Campaign reporting and analysis are included. Frequency NOT PUBLISHED.
report_included: Campaign reporting is named. A sample report is NOT PUBLISHED.
free_entry_offer: Discovery call with an account director
evidence_notes: Testimonials quote 200 leads, a 50%+ conversion rate and 80% of apprenticeships delivered that year. Organisations are not named. Company number 06998651 is printed on the site.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: Qualified conversations
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: A vertical of a general telemarketing business
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: The buyer is purchasing data, callers and a report. A strategy retainer that does not include those will lose this comparison if the buyer's problem is empty diaries.

target_customer: Colleges, universities, ITPs and adult learning services
target_role: Employer engagement, curriculum and business development teams
problem_solved: The provider needs employer conversations, placements or learner outreach aligned to funding targets.
product_description: Scoped calling campaigns for apprenticeships, T Levels, placements, commercial courses, KTPs and business programmes. Success measures are agreed up front and typically include qualified appointments, expressions of interest and opportunities identified. Ongoing programmes are offered as well as one-off campaigns.
report_included: Reporting of appointments and opportunities. A strategy report is NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: No price. Case study does not name the college. Company matched by the Leeds address printed on the site.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: Appointments against a funding target
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Education is a vertical of a call-centre business
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Success is defined as appointments and opportunities, agreed before the campaign. That is a clearer output than a general growth partnership.

target_customer: Schools, trusts, colleges and training providers
problem_solved: In-house teams need practical communications and recruitment skills.
product_description: Tailored workshops and hands-on training. Topics include learner recruitment, staff recruitment, learner engagement and employer or stakeholder engagement.
evidence_notes: Price, duration and a standard toolkit were not published on 2 October 2026. Not re-opened on 5 October 2026.
analysis_likely_funnel_role: Workshop that can lead to agency work
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: An education-only facilitator
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Training sits beside agency fees
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: A CIC already sells this workshop to training providers and does not print a fee. Publishing a price is a difference.

target_customer: Trusts hiring or developing a communications person
problem_solved: A new marcomms hire lacks structure and education-specific practice.
product_description: 18 months of accredited training via Creative Alliance, plus mentoring, templates, a 90-day plan, fortnightly mentor calls, monthly QA and cohort masterclasses.
price_mechanism: NOT PUBLISHED. Whether levy funding covers any of it is NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Inclusions were published. The mentoring fee was not.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A structured hire, not a campaign
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Embeds the firm inside the trust for 18 months
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Fortnightly mentoring plus a 90-day plan is a published shape. The price being hidden is the gap, not the design.

target_customer: Owners and marketing managers, including education providers
problem_solved: No agreed audience, message or priority list.
product_description: Normally 3 to 6 sessions, in person or online. The provider writes the strategy and walks through priorities. Charged at a day or half-day rate. Rates are not published.
format: Workshop series then a written strategy
price: Day rate or half-day rate. Rates NOT PUBLISHED.
done_for_you_included: The strategy is written for the client
report_description: A written marketing strategy and a priority action list
evidence_notes: Not re-opened on 5 October 2026. Education delivery is on a separate sector page.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A written plan
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: The plan creates the retainer
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Three to six sessions ending in a written strategy is the same shape as a diagnostic feeding a partnership. The missing day rate is the evidence gap.

target_customer: Organisations without a full-time senior marketer, including schools, colleges and training providers
problem_solved: Need part-time senior marketing capacity.
product_description: Half day or full day, weekly, fortnightly or monthly. Education page adds rebrands, newsletters, social planning, events and content days.
expert_live_hours: Half day or full day per agreed rhythm. The rate is NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: No numerical day rate on 2 October 2026.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A person for a set number of days
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Sells capacity the buyer already understands
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Buyers may prefer a familiar day rate to a £2,000, £4,000 or £8,000 package. A package needs a boundary a day rate does not have.

target_customer: Education admissions and marketing teams on or buying HubSpot
problem_solved: HubSpot AI is unused or not fitted to education workflows.
product_description: Six one-hour calls, two hours of technical implementation and one hour of project management over six weeks.
expert_live_hours: 6 hours of calls, plus 2 hours implementation and 1 hour project management
evidence_notes: Price and hours from the 2 October 2026 extraction. Not re-opened on 5 October 2026.
analysis_likely_funnel_role: Training that exposes the need for onboarding
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A defined block of expert time
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Sells the method, then the portal build
analysis_likely_margin_profile: Likely higher than onboarding if the six calls are repeatable. Judgement only.
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: £1,175 + VAT for nine provider hours over six weeks is a published education benchmark for a workshop plus a short implementation block.

target_customer: Education teams buying a HubSpot build
problem_solved: A new or unfit portal will not be adopted.
product_description: Four from-price tiers on one page. Essentials from £10,560 + VAT. Enhance from £12,533 + VAT, including the AI masterclass and nine months of guidance. Elevate from £14,126 + VAT, adding marketing strategy sessions. Enterprise from £14,099 + VAT for a longer custom build. These are tiers of one onboarding family.
price: From £10,560 + VAT; from £12,533 + VAT; from £14,126 + VAT; from £14,099 + VAT
strategy_included: Elevate includes marketing strategy consultancy sessions
evidence_notes: Enterprise from-price is slightly below Elevate. Treated as published, not corrected. Not re-opened on 5 October 2026.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A working portal
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: The large project under the training
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: Education CRM implementation starts from £10,560 + VAT. A Growth Partnership at £2,000 to £8,000 a month should not be scoped as a portal build.

target_customer: Education teams that have used HubSpot for at least a year
problem_solved: An existing portal no longer matches the strategy.
product_description: Eight-week audit, fixes, training and handover. Explicitly not for teams with no prior onboarding.
report_included: An audit is included. A standalone report title is NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Not re-opened on 5 October 2026.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A portal that staff have stopped using
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: A smaller project than a new build
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: An eight-week CRM rescue starts from £4,420 + VAT. A pipeline review priced far below that needs a narrower scope.

target_customer: Education marketing, admissions, advancement and leadership teams
problem_solved: Need a low-cost look at HubSpot, AI and admissions before buying implementation.
product_description: One-day in-person event. Early bird price published. Event date was not on the extracted page.
evidence_notes: Date was not on the extracted page on 2 October 2026. Not re-opened on 5 October 2026.
analysis_likely_customer_reason_to_buy: A cheap look before a five-figure project
analysis_likely_supplier_reason_to_offer: Fills the onboarding pipeline
analysis_likely_margin_profile: Low or negative as a product. Judgement.
analysis_lesson_for_four_corners: A £190 + VAT live day is priced as acquisition. The commercial product sits at five figures.
